method: Node VM unit tests against the shipped request and CSV helpers

results.name: Lost business response retries once with unchanged receipt, body and CSRF
Repeated connection loss stops after one retry and warns of uncertain result
Password login is never automatically replayed
Activation-secret mutations are never automatically replayed
HTTP conflict is not retried and preserves diagnostic request ID
Cold-start non-JSON response gives a readable message
Read-only disconnection retries without creating a mutation
CSV quotes and embedded separators remain inside one cell
CSV text formula prefixes, controls and full-width variants are neutralized
CSV numeric amounts and ordinary names remain unchanged
